text:
Hello Professor Alvarez, hello Chris,

I'd like to get our 30-minute meeting on the calendar for next week. The only slot that works on my side is Wednesday at 10:00am — could we take that?

Professor, I understand you have a prior commitment then. I'd be grateful if you could see whether it can be moved; if it genuinely can't, I'd rather we find a time together than drop the meeting, and I'm happy to ask the department office to help us find one.

Chris, does Wednesday 10:00 work for you?

Thanks,
Ajay

Hi Ajay,

Wednesday 10:00 works on my side — my CSE544 lecture ends at 10:00 and my research block doesn't start until 10:30, so 10:00-10:30 is free.

Professor Alvarez: if your 10:00 commitment can't be moved, I'm glad to help find another slot — I can ask the department office for their official schedule, or Ajay can. Either way I'd rather keep the meeting than drop it.

Best,
Chris

Ajay, Chris — noted, and thanks for the flexibility.

Wednesday 10:00-10:30 is the slot I have a standing commitment in (Faculty senate, 10:00-11:00), so let me check with the department office whether it can be moved next week. I'll come back to you as soon as I hear.

Chris: thanks for offering to help with the department office — I'll take that one myself, no need to duplicate the ask.

Hello — Professor Alvarez here.

One question about next week's official schedule: my Wednesday 10:00-11:00 slot is the Faculty senate meeting, and I have an advisee meeting request for exactly 10:00-10:30 next Wednesday (Nov 25). Is the Faculty senate meeting movable that week, and if so to which official slot?

If it cannot be moved, could you tell me which official lectures, seminars or university meetings I have next week outside the hours I already have blocked, so I don't propose a conflicting time?

Thank you,
Professor Alvarez

Understood, Professor — I'll leave the department office to you and keep Wednesday 10:00-10:30 free for now. I'll hold off booking it until you confirm.

Chris

Good morning, Professor Alvarez.

I can't move or reschedule the Faculty senate meeting — that isn't something the office does, and nothing in next week's official schedule is cancelled or moved. As it stands it stays Wed 10:00-11:00, so it overlaps your 10:00-10:30 advisee request.

Official items next week that are not yours (so other rooms/people are committed then):
- Mon 09:00-12:00 CSE444 lecture and section
- Mon 09:00-12:00 CSE581 seminar
- Tue 09:00-13:00 CSE544 lecture and section
- Tue 09:00-15:00 CSE452 lecture and lab
- Wed 09:00-10:00 CSE444 lecture
- Wed 09:00-10:00 CSE544 lecture
- Wed 14:00-17:00 TA office hours
- Thu 09:00-13:00 CSE452 lecture and office hours
- Thu 09:00-13:00 CSE581 seminar
- Fri 09:00-12:00 CSE444 lecture

Your own scheduled hours next week: Mon 09:00-10:00 office hours, Mon 10:30-12:00 CSE455, Mon 15:00-16:30 faculty search committee; Tue 09:30-11:00 CSE455, Tue 13:00-15:00 thesis committee, Tue 15:30-16:30 lab meeting; Wed 09:00-10:00 CSE455, Wed 10:00-11:00 faculty senate, Wed 14:00-15:00 department meeting, Wed 15:30-17:00 office hours; Thu 09:00-10:30 CSE455, Thu 14:00-15:30 seminar; Fri 10:30-12:00 CSE455, Fri 15:00-16:00 faculty meeting.
Thanks, Chris — noted, and please do hold 10:00-10:30 for now. I'll confirm as soon as the department office has answered me.
Thank you — that's exactly what I needed, and I won't ask you to move anything official. I'll work around the senate and find another slot with the students. No further action needed from the office.

Ajay, Chris — I have the answer from the department office, and it's a no on moving anything: the Faculty senate meeting stays Wed 10:00-11:00 next week, and nothing in the official schedule is cancelled or moved. So I can't do Wednesday 10:00-10:30, and I'd rather not drop the meeting either.

My free 30-minute windows next week (my commitments only), in order of preference:

- Wed 12:30-13:00 (right after grant writing, before my 14:00 department meeting)
- Wed 15:00-15:30
- Thu 12:00-12:30
- Mon 12:00-12:30
- Fri 12:00-12:30

Ajay: do any of these work on your side? Chris: which of them fit your lectures and research blocks? If two or three of them are fine for both of you, tell me your best one and I'll book it and confirm.

Note on the official rooms: the department also told me which hours are committed elsewhere (e.g. Wed 09:00-10:00 has CSE444 and CSE544 lectures), so if neither of you has a room free we can ask the office for one of the hours above.
You're welcome, Professor. If anything else about the schedule comes up, just write.
Alvarez closed out: acknowledged, nothing pending. Waiting on root's answer about my name/gender; ajay and chris have written nothing yet.

Professor — thanks for getting the answer. I checked all five windows against my week, and unfortunately each one lands inside a fixed block of mine:

- Mon 12:00-12:30 — Lab (12:00-17:00)
- Wed 12:30-13:00 — Research (10:30-14:00)
- Wed 15:00-15:30 — TA office hours (14:00-17:00)
- Thu 12:00-12:30 — CSE581 seminar (09:00-13:00)
- Fri 12:00-12:30 — Research (12:00-17:00)

My only genuinely free half hour next week is Wed 10:00-10:30, which is exactly the one you can't do.

That said, not all of my blocks are equally rigid: lectures, the seminar and office hours are fixed, but my research blocks I can shift with a bit of notice. So if Wed 12:30-13:00 also works for Ajay, I'm happy to move my Wednesday research start to 13:00 and take 12:30-13:00 — that's my pick. If Ajay can't do Wednesday, tell me which of the others he can and I'll look at whether I can rearrange around it.

On rooms: I don't hold a room next week, so if we settle on Wed 12:30-13:00, it may be worth folding that into your ask to the office.

Chris

Professor, thank you for pushing on it and for the list — and Chris, thanks for holding the slot.

Honest answer: none of the five windows fit my week as it stands.

- Wed 12:30-13:00 and Wed 15:00-15:30: my research block is Wed 10:30-13:00 and my TA grading is Wed 13:00-17:00.
- Thu 12:00-12:30: that's inside my CSE452 lecture and office hours (Thu 09:00-13:00).
- Mon 12:00-12:30 and Fri 12:00-12:30: both inside my research blocks.

The only flexible part of my week is my research time — lectures, labs, TA grading and office hours aren't mine to move. So:

1. I can give up 30 minutes of research on Wednesday, which makes your first choice, Wed 12:30-13:00, work on my side. Chris, does that fit your Wednesday?
2. If Wednesday doesn't suit Chris, Mon 12:00-12:30 or Fri 12:00-12:30 work for me the same way.

Wed 10:00-10:30 is still the only slot that costs me nothing, so if anything shifts there, that's still my first choice. I don't have a room booked, so whichever slot we land on, we'd need one from the office.

Ajay

Hello,

I'm trying to arrange a 30-minute meeting with Professor Alvarez and Chris next week, and I'd like to check it against the official schedule rather than guess.

Could you send me next week's official schedule — lectures, seminars and university meetings, including the Faculty senate meeting? And of these hours, could you tell me which have a room free: Wed 12:30-13:00, Wed 15:00-15:30, Thu 12:00-12:30, Mon 12:00-12:30, Fri 12:00-12:30?

Thank you,
Ajay

Thanks, Chris — that's clear and useful. Wed 12:30-13:00 is my own preference too, so let's make it the working plan: I'll keep it held, and I've asked the office whether a room is free then. I'll confirm once Ajay says it works for him.

One more thing, and then I think we're done.

I'm trying to place a 30-minute advisee meeting (Ajay, Chris and me) on Wednesday 12:30-13:00 next week — it doesn't clash with my own commitments. Is a room free then, and can it be booked for us? If Wednesday 12:30-13:00 is not available, my fallbacks are Thu 12:00-12:30, Mon 12:00-12:30 or Fri 12:00-12:30 — could you tell me which of those has a room?

No need to move anything official; I just need to know what's free.

Thank you,
Professor Alvarez

Chris — that's a match: Wed 12:30-13:00 works for me too (I'd shift my Wednesday research block the same way, starting at 13:00 after my TA grading... apologies, my grading is 13:00-17:00, so I'd take 12:30-13:00 out of research and keep grading as it is).

Professor — so our best one is **Wednesday 12:30-13:00**. If you can book that, please do, and I'll put it in my calendar. I've already asked the department office about a room for it; I'll pass on whatever they say.

Ajay

Ajay — yes, Wednesday 12:30-13:00 fits me: I'll shift my Wednesday research block to start at 13:00 and run to 14:00, so 12:30-13:00 is clear.

Professor: Wed 12:30-13:00 is my best one, and it sounds like it's Ajay's too. If you book that, please count us both in — and since neither of us has a room, we'd need one from the office for that half hour.

Chris

Hello Ajay,

Here is next week's official schedule:

Mon 09:00-10:00 Office hours (Professor Alvarez)
Mon 09:00-12:00 CSE444 lecture and section
Mon 09:00-12:00 CSE581 seminar
Mon 10:30-12:00 CSE455 lecture (Professor Alvarez)

Against your five candidate half-hours:
- Wed 12:30-13:00 — no official item, free on the official schedule
- Wed 15:00-15:30 — no official item (TA office hours run 14:00-17:00 but that is not an item in this list), free on the official schedule
- Thu 12:00-12:30 — occupied: CSE452 lecture and office hours 09:00-13:00, CSE581 seminar 09:00-13:00
- Mon 12:00-12:30 — no official item (CSE444 and CSE581 end at 12:00, CSE455 ends at 12:00), free on the official schedule
- Fri 12:00-12:30 — no official item (CSE444 and CSE455 end at 12:00), free on the official schedule

I only have the official schedule: I don't know people's private appointments, so a slot free here isn't a guarantee that someone is available. And I don't arrange other people's meetings — you'd need to confirm times with Professor Alvarez and Chris directly.

Ajay, that's the answer I was hoping for — thank you both for moving your research time.

**Settled: Wednesday 12:30-13:00, 30 minutes, the three of us.**

It's on my calendar now. Chris: please shift your research start to 13:00 on Wednesday as you offered. Ajay: you have the 30 minutes of research back for that slot.

Remaining item is the room. I've asked the department office whether Wednesday 12:30-13:00 is free and to book it for us; if it isn't, I'll take the first of Thu 12:00-12:30 / Mon 12:00-12:30 / Fri 12:00-12:30 that has a room and tell you right away. Ajay, on Wednesday 10:00: nothing has shifted, so it stays where it is — I'll let you know if that ever changes.

I'll send a short confirmation once the office answers on the room.

Good — all three of us match on Wednesday 12:30-13:00, and it's booked on my calendar.

Ajay: on the room, no need to duplicate — I've already asked the office whether that half hour is free and to book it for us. When they answer (or if they say it's taken, in which case I'll pick from Thu 12:00-12:30 / Mon 12:00-12:30 / Fri 12:00-12:30), I'll send you both one short confirmation and that's it from my side.

Good — then Wed 12:30-13:00 it is, pending the room. Professor, I'll wait for your confirmation, then put it in my calendar. Thanks both.

Chris

Hello again, Professor.

I don't have a room-booking system here, so I can't book anything for you — I can only tell you what next week's official schedule shows about those half-hours:

- Wed 12:30-13:00 — no official item, nothing listed
- Thu 12:00-12:30 — occupied: CSE452 lecture and office hours 09:00-13:00 and CSE581 seminar 09:00-13:00 run through it
- Mon 12:00-12:30 — no official item (CSE444, CSE581 and CSE455 all end at 12:00)
- Fri 12:00-12:30 — no official item (CSE444 and CSE455 end at 12:00)

"Nothing listed" only means no lecture, seminar or university meeting is scheduled then; it isn't a statement that a particular room is free, and I don't know anyone's private appointments. Room allocation and the booking itself would be with the department's room scheduling, not the office front desk.

Thank you — that's exactly what I needed, and I've passed it on. We've settled on Wed 12:30-13:00 with Professor Alvarez and Chris; Professor Alvarez is handling the room with you. No further action needed from me.

Ajay

Thanks for letting me know, Ajay. One thing so nobody waits on me: I don't do room bookings — I only read the official schedule. Professor Alvarez knows that, and the room itself is with the department's room scheduling.

Confirmation, as promised — we're on.

**Wednesday 12:30-13:00, my office.** Chris, you can put it in your calendar now; Ajay, same for you.

The department office told me it doesn't handle room bookings at all, and that Wed 12:30-13:00 has no official lecture, seminar or university meeting — so there's nothing to collide with. Rather than chase the room scheduling people for a half hour, let's just use my office; I'll be there from 12:30. If either of you would rather have a booked room, say so and I'll follow it up, but it isn't needed for us to meet.

That closes this from my side: Wednesday 12:30-13:00, 30 minutes, the three of us.

Understood, thank you — Wed 12:30-13:00 then, and we'll use my office instead of a booked room, so nothing further is needed from the office. If room scheduling ever has a half hour for us, that's a bonus, not a requirement.
Understood — Wed 12:30-13:00 in your office then. Nothing pending on my side.

Professor — confirmed on my side: **Wednesday 12:30-13:00, your office**, and it's in my calendar. Your office is fine by me; no need to chase room scheduling for half an hour.

Thanks for pushing the 10:00 slot as far as it would go, and Chris, thanks for moving your research block. See you both Wednesday.

Ajay
Perfect — Wednesday 12:30-13:00 in my office, and you're both confirmed. Nothing more needed from either of you; see you then.

Professor — your office is fine by me too, no need to chase room scheduling. It's in my calendar: **Wednesday 12:30-13:00, your office**, with my research block shifted to 13:00-14:00.

Thanks both — see you Wednesday.

Chris
